_meta.status: UNVERIFIED reference values. Every entry has pharmacist_approved=false until the pharmacist session (PS_ANALYSIS.md section 4, questions 2-3). The UI must show them as unverified.
_meta.how_to_approve: Edit the value if the pharmacist corrects it, set pharmacist_approved to true, and put the pharmacist's name and date in `approved_by`.
_meta.units: mg per day unless stated. Ingredient ids are Track A canonical ids (public/data/ingredients.json).

sos._note: Worst-case doses per day assumed for an SOS (as needed) line when the prescription gives no maximum. 'Doses' means tablets/capsules/measures. Example values from PS_ANALYSIS.md section 4 question 3; pharmacist to set.

risk_caps.source: Product information for paracetamol advises a lower dose in liver disease but gives no single number; 3,000 mg/day is a commonly applied draft cap. Pharmacist or NFI to set the number.

paracetamol._note: The age-65 cap (3,000 mg/day) was removed 24 Oct 2026 (FIX_PLAN 2.4): age alone does not lower the paracetamol maximum; liver disease, heavy alcohol use and low weight do.
